description: Modifier, list after github>gander-settings/renovate. Automerge patch updates, minor updates of stable (>= 1.0) dependencies, GitHub Actions pins and digests, pins of other dependencies, weekly lock file maintenance and vulnerability fixes, once every check on the branch is green or skipped (not only the required ones). Major updates and minor updates of 0.x dependencies are never automerged.

packageRules.description: Automerge minor updates of stable (>= 1.0) dependencies once CI is green
Automerge GitHub Actions pins and digest bumps
Automerge pins from config:best-practices (exact versions for npm devDependencies, digests for Docker images): the version stays the same, only the reference gets exact, so CI is the gate
Automerge the weekly lock file maintenance PR once CI is green: it stays within the existing constraints, so CI is the gate
Block automerge for minor updates of 0.x dependencies: under SemVer a 0.x minor may break the API
